name: release-notes
description: Draft partner-facing release notes from the same commits as the changelog. Triggers on "draft release notes", "release notes for the next version", "/release-notes", "нотатки релізу", "release notes партнеру". Same input as curate-changelog, different audience and tone: a short, benefit-first narrative for a user or partner — "what's new for you" — not a categorized engineer's list. Keeps only changes a user actually notices; drops internal refactors and tooling. Prints the notes to the chat to seed a GitHub Release description or a partner announcement. Writes no file.
